title: Empowering Educators in Morocco: Our New Partnership with Bridge Education Group
markdown:
![Business/Corporate English Language Training for Companies/Employees](https://bridge.edu/languages/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/logo-bridge-color-1.svg)

# 

We’re thrilled to share exciting news with our community: **American Group International** is now officially partnered with **Bridge Education Group**, a global leader in teacher training and professional development.

## Why Bridge?

Bridge has over 30 years of experience in delivering accredited **TEFL/TESOL** certification programs to aspiring and experienced educators around the world. Their courses are recognized for quality, flexibility, and global relevance ,  making them a perfect fit for Morocco’s growing demand for English language education.

## What This Means for You

Through this partnership, educators in Morocco can now access Bridge’s full catalog of online teacher training programs, including:

- Professional TEFL/TESOL Certifications
- Specialized Micro-Credentials (e.g., Teaching Young Learners, Teaching Online)
- Flexible, self-paced learning options

Whether you’re just starting your teaching journey or looking to upgrade your skills, Bridge offers internationally recognized credentials that open doors to teaching opportunities worldwide.

## Join the Movement

We invite educators, schools, and institutions across Morocco to explore these transformative programs. As an affiliate partner, we’re proud to offer a **10% discount** on all Bridge courses , plus personalized guidance to help you choose the right path.

Click below to explore Bridge’s accredited courses and take the next step in your teaching career.

 [Explore Courses](https://bridge.edu/tefl/storefront/go/?sid=juliewilburn)

## Let’s Build the Future of Education Together

At American Group International, we believe in empowering educators with the tools they need to succeed. This partnership with Bridge is a major step forward, and we’re excited to see how it transforms classrooms across Morocco.

For inquiries, collaboration opportunities, or to learn more about becoming a certified TEFL instructor, feel free to [contact us](/contact).
